contract: Local synthetic-data UI prototype. Compare A/B/C information architecture and D/E/F Termius-inspired styling. 24 synthetic hosts, 12 initially open sessions. Avoid duplicated host lists; A/C/D/E/F have no per-session top tabs, B caps visible tabs at 3 without closing connections. No real SSH/RDP/VNC or secret access.

accessibility.evidence: Checked labeled buttons/forms, Ctrl K session search, Tab containment and Escape focus return in dialogs, read-only confirmation/input disabling, keyboard switching of B tabs, inspector Escape return, and reduced-motion handling. This is a focused prototype check, not a full WCAG or screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: All six studies rendered at desktop, 1024x768 and 390x844 with no horizontal page overflow. Below 600px navigation becomes a dismissible drawer. Terminal lines scroll internally; task panes stack. Fixed VNC preview window containment in short split panes.

loading.evidence: Visible progress with cancel; cancellation returns to current work area. Screenshot retained for both prototype sets.

empty.evidence: Zero open sessions shows a useful choose-host recovery action; missing search matches show empty search feedback.

error.evidence: Specific connection timeout with same-view retry; simulated retry restores terminal. Checked readable light-theme error background.

partial.evidence: One failing host is named while other connection content stays available; no blanket success state.

success.evidence: Connected indicators, synthetic hostname command consumption, host selection, 12-session switching, 3-tab cap, and focus/split restoration checked.

permission.evidence: Prototype input policy: view-only mode disables input, names the target, and requires confirmation before enabling control. This is a frontend policy demonstration, not server authorization proof.
